description: Add new ad groups. Each must include Name, CampaignId, RegionIds, and optionally type-specific settings. Use when the user asks to create ad groups inside a campaign. Do not use it to edit an existing group; call update_adgroups. Do not use it to list groups; call get_adgroups.

items_json.description: JSON array of ad group objects, e.g. [{"Name":"My Group","CampaignId":12345,"RegionIds":[225]}]

name: add_adgroups
